english: This is the scene!\nAlpha, Beta! Keep watch on the surroundings!
Meow!
Woof!
A victim!\nHey-wake up, please!\nYou can't sleep in a place like this!
Zzz... mmnya-mmnya...
Shaking him doesn't wake him at all...?\n...I see.
This calls for\nmy "guaranteed-to-wake-you alarm watch."
Now, wake up for me!
// SFX: alarm ringing. See anime. Sound: "tee-teen-teen-teen-teen."
Ngh... huh? Wha-???
So, how's it feel waking up on the street?
Huh? I was sleeping HERE!?
That's right.\nDid the drowsiness hit you all of a sudden?
No, I wasn't tired or\nanything like that...\nSo why'd I conk out?
You didn't have a bad dream or anything?
Dunno, can't remember while I was asleep.
I see...
// Fade to black: time passes\n// Background: town (night)
Thank you so much.\n...But why did I fall asleep, I wonder?\nStrange things do happen, don't they?
Indeed.\nWell, take care now.
Yes.
That makes five victims at this scene.\nThirteen total with yesterday and the day before.\nDefinitely abnormal.
People suddenly fall asleep on the street and can't be woken.\nIf the range and number of these incidents keeps growing,\nit'll lead to large-scale accidents or crimes.
Inspector Sakaki says it might be the dream demons' doing,\nbut...
Meeooow!!
What is it, Alpha?\nDid you find someone asleep?
Nya-nya-nya-nya-nya!
What!? A sleeping person is being attacked by a dream demon!?\nGot it, lead the way!
// Fade to black: time passes\n// Background: town (night)
Woof woof woof!!
Beta!\nYou guarded the sleeping person well!\nLeave the rest to me!
// Event art: Remu leveling her magnum
That said, all I can rely on right now\nis this magnum loaded with silver dum-dum rounds.
If I could only use my powers...\nI could wipe out dream demons like these in no time...!
Calm and precise... take it down, Remu!
// To battle map: town (night)
Let's go! Prepare yourself!
// Battle start\n// Allied reinforcements appear after defeating a set number of dream demons or a set number of turns
This many is getting to be a real pain...!
// Light appears on screen
Ugh, what!?
// Meru, Noel, Claude, and Tsubasa appear
Whoa!? It's dark!!
Hawawawaaahh!\n[NOEL]'s fault-\nwe got flung to the very first block of hell, desuuu!
...Um, isn't it just nighttime?
Watch out! There's something weird here!
// A dream demon appears near Meru and the others
I-it's out, desuu!?\nBut just like the last one,\nit's sooo preeetty, desuuu!
Umm, the pretty one from before... hmm?\nThat means...
You there!\nAre YOU the ones who summoned the dream demons?
These are called dream demons?\nFirst time I've ever seen such a thing!
Dream demons attack people! Run!
If they attack people,\nI can't just run away.\n...Good thing I came prepared for a fight, just in case.
Way to go!
We'll fight too, desuu!!
Um... let's run awayy.
You know, running away at a time like this\nusually makes you victim number one, but\nyou're fine with that? Really fine with that??
Uuuugh, (I wanna run but I can't,\nwanna run but I can't, wanna run\nbut I can't, wanna run but...)
I'll back you up as much as I can!\nHang in there somehow!
Understood!\nFiend! Taste the blade of the guardian!
Whoa! So coool!!\nAlright! I'll try it too!!
As long as evil exists in this world...\numm, what was the rest?
(Huh... is this spook actually listening politely?)
// Battle resumes\n// Black Tiffania appears when dream demons fall below a set number
Hm? Who are you?
Hey... will you be my sacrifice...?\nMy very first... sacrifice...
Don't say terrifying things so casually!
Is this one a dream demon too?
Doesn't seem like it... but those ears-\ncould she be a dark elf or something?
Who? Dark-elf? Friend? Foe?
No idea.\nBut I'm not about to become someone's sacrifice!
// Battle resumes\n// Event triggers when Black Tiffania is defeated
You'll... regret this...
What does that mean...?
Not sure, but\nshe doesn't seem keen on a real fight.
W-what kind of person... I mean,\nI don't know if she's even a person... desuu?
Hmm, I'll have to look into it.
// After all enemies are wiped out, event on the map
Fuuuhh! I'm beat, desuuu!!
Huh? What's that?
// Sonico appears
Uhyaah!\nMan, one thing after another-we're swamped!
U-ummm, pardon meeee!
Hawawawa, she's talking to us, desuu!
Well, she IS human. Of course she talks.
Sorry to bother you while you're busy!
She's, uh, bowing\nwith incredible force...?
Ye-es! What is it?
Haa, haa...\nUm, is this the right place for\nthe photo book shoot!?
Huh? A shoot... this isn't one, though?
Ah...!\nI-I'm so sorry!
Am I... lost...?\nB-but I gotta keep looking my best...!
Uuuugh! Hiyah!
// Sonico leaves.
Someone you know?
[CLAUDE], she was just as\nscatterbrained as you, no?
I don't think I know her...\nBut what's a photo book?
Not, huh?\nWell, let's calm down for now.
// Battle over
Man, [MERU]'s taste is\nas off-kilter as ever-\nthat almost got us killed.
It is NOT off, and cute is\ncute, desuu!!
That's right!!\nUm, um, thank you\nso much for helping us, desuu!
No need-you saved me too.\nI was in a situation where I couldn't afford to waste time.
// SFX: police siren
Sounds like the commotion\ngot the police moving.\nThat settles things for now.
Police?
Yes. I'm Remu Ayanokouji.\nA detective specializing in paranormal cases.\nI'm on good terms with the police.
You exterminate\nthose spooky things from before, desuu?
That's right. Those are dream demons-\ndemons that come from the demon world and attack people.
They normally appear inside dreams, but\nsometimes they materialize and act like that.
You're less a detective, more a monster exterminator.
Well, officially I'm a detective.\nSo, what about you all?\nYou appeared out of nowhere like teleportation.
Um, desuu...
// Fade to black: time passes
You came from a different world...?
Um, well,\nI... I thought you might not believe me,\nb-but desuu...!
Hehe! You're more nervous\nthan when you were fighting dream demons. Cute!
[MERU]'s shy around strangers.\nHonestly, she's totally different\nfrom when she talks to me...
Relax, relax!\nI'm not THAT scary, am I?
Y-yes, desuuu...\nI'm sorry, desuu...
So, what kind of world did you come from?
You believe us?
Not to brag, but\nI've had my share of strange experiences.
Besides,\nI don't think this girl could lie if she tried.
H-hawawa... I'm sorry, desuu...
Come to think of it, she's acting\npretty different from when I showed up, no?
When you arrived, Tsubasa, I was even MORE flustered...\nyees, desuuu...
We've fought together now,\nwe're not strangers anymore, right?
Uu, I'm so glad\nboth you and Remu are such kind people, desuu...!
You say you've had many strange experiences, but\nare people appearing from other worlds\nnot unusual around here?
I'll need to look into that.\nI've been focused lately on the "sudden street-sleeping phenomenon"\ncase, so I don't know about anything else.
The "sudden street-sleeping phenomenon"?
People walking down the street suddenly fall asleep\nand can't be woken.\nCause is still unknown.
This is one of the scenes, and\nthat's where the dream demons-and you lot-showed up.
It's all one big mystery, desuu?
Something like that.
Ah! Oh no!\nI'm the only one who can wake\nthe sleeping people!
Sorry! I'll head to the police station right away\nand wake the sleepers!
Here, my card!\nIt's got my office address on it,\nso come visit sometime!
Huh? Ah... hey, wait!
See ya!
Auuuuh, she's gone, desuu...
// Sonico's voice is heard.
Uu...\nS-so, which way is the shoot location...!
Hunya? Whose voice was that?
It's the headphone girl from before, desuu!
She's still looking for something.\nPoor thing-alright!\nLet's help her out!
H-hold on!!\nWE'VE got\nour own problems, desuu...
C'mon, even our teacher said to help people in need!\nBefore that, though-what kind of person ARE you!?
We don't know left from right here-\nhow do you think WE can help\nsomeone find something, desuu?
You never know till you try!
Geez, you're always all momentum...\nDo whatever you want, desuu.
OK! Okay!! Leave it to me!\nMy magical magic'll solve it in one shot!
I can't leave it to you, desuu!\nMaking MORE problems is\n[NOEL]'s worst habit, desuuu!
Don't be so mad.\nPersonally,\nI'm with [NOEL] on this.
Huh...?
As a guardian,\nI can't abandon someone in need.
See, seee! Ahem!!\nAnd it's not like those dream demon things\ncouldn't show up again.
But...
Here's what we'll do.
[NOEL] and I will go\nlook for that girl, and you head\nto the Ayanokouji Detective Agency first. How's that?
We can call if anything happens.\nDon't worry.
Unyuu...\nIf you say so, Tsubasa... okay, desuu.
Um, what about me...?
Hwauh!? That's right!\nYou were here too!!
You've got no presence, desuu.\nIf you don't state your opinion clearly,\npeople forget you, desuu.
Don't go by others' will-decide for yourself.\nNo one can take responsibility for you.
You're right...\nChase after that girl from before, or\ngo to the Ayanokouji Detective Agency... what should I do?
// Choice\n// Search for the girl with Tsubasa and Noel\n// Go to the Ayanokouji Detective Agency with Meru
Understood.\nThough I'm worried about\n[MERU] being on her own.
I'm fine, desuu! My magical yo-yo is\na martial art rooted in ancient assassination techniques!\nAs long as I walk without leaving an opening, I'm fine, desuu.
That's right! With OUR techniques,\nthere's nothing to worry about!!
[NOEL] tends to rush ahead,\nso don't be a bother to Tsubasa!
Ha ha... [MERU],\nyou're like\n[NOEL]'s mom.
I am NOT, desuu!!
She's not!!
Ehhh, with ME, desuuu?
(Uwaah... she thinks I'm dead weight... alright!)
I-I'm a man, so\nI want to p-protect\nMiss [MERU]...
Well, numbers-wise it's balanced,\nso why not.
With [CLAUDE] along,\nwe've got healing covered.
True.\n[MERU], I'm counting on you\nwith [CLAUDE].
I'm not thrilled, but understood, desuuu.
(Uuuugh, isn't the way they treat me... harsh?)
(Can't lose heart, can't lose heart,\ncan't lose heart, can't lose heart...)
...wait, huh? Nobody's here!?\nHeeey! Waaait for meeee!
Wh-what was that...
I-I don't know, desuu...
But right now,\nwe've got Soul Link active, desuu.
Soul Link?
Yes, desuu.
Reluctantly, [NOEL] and I\nshare the same Soul, desuu.
Muuugh, that was casually cruel...\nwell, whatever.
What's a Soul?
A Soul is like\na person's individuality, desuu.
When someone with the same Soul is\ninside your Sympathy Area,\nSoul Link activates, desuu.
The active Soul Link\ngrants all kinds of effects, desuu!
So if you stick together with\nallies who share your Soul,\nbattles might go your way, desuu!
// Show still image: active link list displayed
You can check which Soul Links are active\non screen while moving and such, desuu!
I see-checking who has what Soul\nwhile fighting might be fun!
// Display off
...Still, what WAS\nthat phenomenon just now, desuu...?
Huh, what's this.
Ah, that's a Skill Coin, desuu.
Skill Coin?
Our teacher taught us before, desuu!\nYou don't remember, desuu?
Umm...
It's fine, it's fine!\nOf course I remember!
I hope so, desuu...
Knew it, desuu...
Ehehe...
Sigh, then I'll explain, so\nlisten well, desuu.
// Show still image: coin equip screen
Skill Coins have various skills sealed inside;\nequip one and you can use its skill, desuu.
Some hold 'restricted skills' you can't use\nunless you equip a specific color combination, desuu.
// ↓ unused
Some hold 'restricted skills' you can't use\nunless you equip a specific color combination, desuu.

For skills showing a Skill Coin icon in the ○ part,
you can't use the skill unless you've equipped\nexactly that color combination of Skill Coins, so be careful, desuu!
// Display off
Also, Skill Coins can\nboost your attribute's power, desuu!
// Display off
The more Skill Coins of your attribute's color you equip,\nthe bigger the damage when you attack\nan attribute you have the advantage over, desuu!
Equipping Skill Coins in your attribute's color\nboosts damage AND lets you use skills-great deal, desuu!
Got it!
// Display off
You can only equip 3 Skill Coins at once, so\nbalance them out and find the best combo, desuu!
// Display off
You can get Skill Coins\nin all sorts of places, desuu.
According to our teacher,\nyou can't get lots of them unless you enter\na certain mode, desuu!
Not sure what that's about, though...
Got Skill Coins mostly figured out, desuu?
When you get a Skill Coin,\nmake sure to equip it, desuu?
